clue.text: Assembles for prayers

definitions.meaning: short set prayers in the Anglican and Catholic liturgy

explanation.surface: Someone gathers a congregation for a service of prayers.
explanation.definitionFit: Gathers is a verb synonym; the noun names short liturgical prayers read on set days.

clue.text: Spoke of alternative possible date

parts.note: OR is the word that introduces an alternative

indicators.note: a possible version of the word is one of its rearrangements

explanation.surface: Someone talks about another date that might suit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alternative' looks like an adjective on 'date', but it is the little word OR; 'possible' then reshuffles the date's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoke formally, as in giving a speech, is the past tense of the verb meaning to declaim.

clue.text: Check breaking point

definitions.meaning: the furthest extent that can be endured

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: to restrict something, and the boundary beyond which nothing more is possible.

clue.text: Find fault with record in woodworking

parts.note: to carp is to complain pettily
an entry is an item written in a record or log

explanation.surface: A critic complains about a logged item in a woodwork class.
explanation.definitionFit: Carpentry is the craft of shaping and joining timber, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Master, one taking physical exercise?

definitions.meaning: someone who skips with a rope, a whimsical sense

explanation.surface: A ship's master is spotted doing his workout.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship's captain is commonly called this; playfully it also names a person jumping rope.

clue.text: Salad item makes a girl come out in spots

indicators.note: the girl's name comes out inside the word for spots, so it goes into it

parts.note: a rash is an outbreak of spots on the skin
Di is a short girl's name

explanation.surface: Eating something from the salad bowl gives a young woman a skin outbreak.
explanation.definitionFit: This red root vegetable is a common raw salad ingredient.

clue.text: Concentrate to cut off top of hedge

indicators.note: the first letter of the shrub's name is removed, the top of a down entry

parts.note: privet is a shrub commonly grown as a hedge

explanation.surface: Gardening instruction to focus on trimming the hedge top.
explanation.definitionFit: To rivet attention is to hold it fixed, so the verb matches concentrating.

clue.text: Pepys said sadly it might be the result of unwise eating

definitions.text: it might be the result of unwise eating

indicators.note: a sad state of the letters is a disordered one, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: The diarist Samuel Pepys mournfully remarks on the price of overeating.
explanation.walkthrough: Samuel Pepys was a seventeenth-century English diarist famous for describing his meals.
explanation.definitionFit: Indigestion is the medical sense, a classic consequence of eating badly.

clue.text: Not the only part of the UK wanting tax to come down

definitions.text: Not the only part of the UK

parts.note: scot is an old word for a tax, as in scot-free
to land is to come down to earth

explanation.surface: A grumble that one region of Britain wants lower taxes.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the four nations of the United Kingdom, hence a part but not the only one.

clue.text: Beat decisively in field event

definitions.meaning: the athletics throw using a weight on a wire

explanation.definitionFit: Informally to thrash an opponent; also the athletics throwing contest with a ball on a wire.

clue.text: He suffers from depression

parts.note: read not as a mental-health complaint but as someone whose money is hit by an economic slump

explanation.surface: A man is struggling with his mental health.
explanation.definitionFit: A person putting money into shares loses out when an economic depression strikes.

clue.text: Pay to reside at university

parts.note: to settle somewhere is to make a home there
up means in residence at a university, especially Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: A student pays rent to live in college.
explanation.definitionFit: Clearing what you owe a bill is idiomatically to square the account, the phrasal verb sense.

clue.text: This singer, given a chance, could win a fortune

definitions.meaning: a boy soprano, the highest choral voice

definitions.text: given a chance, could win a fortune
definitions.meaning: a bet on three selections where all winnings roll on

explanation.definitionFit: The high boy chorister's voice; also a three-horse accumulator bet that pays big if all win.

clue.text: Bold to break in using a jemmy?

parts.note: to enter a building, here forcibly
prising means levering open, which a jemmy (crowbar) does

explanation.surface: A burglar boldly forces a window with a crowbar.
explanation.walkthrough: A jemmy is the British word for a short burglar's crowbar.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing initiative and daring, so bold in the sense of adventurous.

clue.text: Providing a subject with a title?

definitions.text: Providing a subject with a title?

parts.words: Providing a subject with a title?
parts.note: not naming a topic, but raising a royal subject to the peerage

explanation.surface: Someone is choosing a heading for an essay topic.
explanation.definitionFit: Conferring a peerage on someone raises them to the nobility with a rank and title.

clue.text: Cause one to remember it's time for church?

definitions.meaning: literally sounding a bell to call worshippers

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to seem familiar; literally, tolling a bell summons people to service.

clue.text: One girl I converted to the faith

indicators.note: converted means changed in form, so the letters are rearranged, fitting a faith theme

explanation.surface: A young woman has converted to a new faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A system of belief and worship, which a faith is.

clue.text: Navy planes in sorry state

indicators.note: a sorry state of the letters is a jumbled one

explanation.surface: Naval aircraft are in poor condition.
explanation.definitionFit: An American state, home of Philadelphia and Pittsburgh.

clue.text: Energy surrounding volcano in Asian land

indicators.note: the energy word goes around the volcano

parts.note: vim is vigour or energy
Etna is the active volcano in Sicily

explanation.surface: Vigour around a volcanic region of Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: A country in South-East Asia.

clue.text: Promise to hook up

definitions.meaning: to connect or interlock, as gears do

explanation.definitionFit: To pledge oneself, as to marry; also for gears or parts to mesh and connect.

clue.text: Container of uniform capacity?

parts.note: not boxes all the same size, but a bag holding a soldier's uniform

explanation.surface: A set of identical-sized containers.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier's bag for carrying uniform and gear, so it contains uniform.

clue.text: Flash of brilliance

parts.note: not a sudden clever idea but a literal brief sparkle of light

explanation.definitionFit: A brief sparkle of reflected light, literally a flash of brightness.

clue.text: Demanding much in either effort or money

definitions.text: Demanding much in either effort or money

parts.words: Demanding much in either effort or money
parts.note: both senses: a task that is very hard, and extracting payment from someone

explanation.surface: Describes a job that is costly in work or cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Means requiring great effort, and also extorting money, as in exacting a fee.

clue.text: Card that's sweet about love

indicators.note: the sweet goes about, around, the love

parts.note: a tart is a sweet pastry
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A Valentine card that is sickly sweet about love.
explanation.definitionFit: One of a deck used in fortune-telling.

clue.text: Commons vote leads to disagreement

definitions.meaning: in the House of Commons members vote by dividing into lobbies
a split or discord between parties

explanation.walkthrough: The House of Commons is the elected chamber of the UK Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: The parliamentary vote where members separate into lobbies; also a split in opinion.

clue.text: Organ swell that may affect one's hearing

parts.note: the ear is the organ of hearing
to wax is to grow or swell, as the moon does

explanation.surface: Church organ music swells, which may be hard on the ears.
explanation.definitionFit: The waxy secretion in the ear canal can block it and dull hearing.

clue.text: Man on board, Sir

definitions.meaning: the title given to one dubbed by the monarch

explanation.definitionFit: A chess piece on the board; also one entitled to be addressed as Sir.

clue.text: Driver of train having crossed lines

definitions.text: Driver of train having crossed lines

parts.words: Driver of train having crossed lines
parts.note: not a railway engineer but someone driving a pack train of animals bred from horse and donkey

explanation.surface: A railway driver who went through the wrong points.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who drives mules, which are hybrids born of crossed breeding lines.
